title: Make it easier for Distributions to customize pinned applications on taskmanager applet
line: Distributions can change the defaults of any widget, such as the Task Manager's pinned apps, with a plasma-<widget id>-defaultsrc file in the XDG config dirs.
explanation: Since the port to plasma_add_applet, applets such as the Task Manager compile main.xml into the plugin, so distributions can no longer patch or sed it to change defaults like the pinned apps and have to rebuild the package. KConfigLoader takes its fallback values only from main.xml, and nothing let a distribution replace them. Applet::configScheme() in libplasma now looks for a plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc file in the XDG config dirs (e.g. /etc/xdg) and, if it exists, replaces the <default> of each main.xml entry with the value of the same group and key before KConfigLoader reads it, so the config skeleton's own fallback is the distribution's value for every applet.

commits.message:
applet: let distributions override the defaults of main.xml

Applets now embed main.xml, so distributions can't patch it to change
defaults like the Task Manager's pinned apps. The groups and keys of a
plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc file in the XDG config dirs replace them.

BUG: 511560

media.caption: Pure master with plasma-org.kde.plasma.icontasks-defaultsrc and plasma-org.kde.plasma.taskmanager-defaultsrc ([General] launchers=Konsole, Dolphin, Info Center): the default bottom panel and a new top panel (Icons-only Task Manager + Task Manager) still show System Settings, Discover, Files, Browser.
Same files and steps with the fix: all three Task Managers show Konsole, Dolphin and Info Center.

review.text: Making main.xml defaults overridable through a plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc file in libplasma's Applet::configScheme() is the right generic answer to the wish, and the media and regression notes show it working (new and existing Task Managers, explicit user values kept, clock Bool/Enum entries). But it gets there by parsing and re-serialising main.xml with QXmlStreamReader/Writer into a QBuffer before KConfigLoader reads it, which works around KConfigLoader (kconfig) having no way to override <default> values. That XML round trip is fragile (drops <default> attributes such as code="true", duplicates KConfigLoader's own parsing rules for group/key/name) and maintainers are likely to ask for it to live in KConfigLoader.
changes: Add the override to kconfig's KConfigLoader instead: e.g. a constructor or setter taking a KConfig/KConfigGroup of default overrides that ConfigLoaderHandler applies when it reads each entry's <default> (same group + key/name lookup), with an autotest in kconfig.
In libplasma, drop applyDefaults() and the QBuffer/XML rewriting and just open the plasma-<plugin id>-defaultsrc KConfig and pass it to that new KConfigLoader API in Applet::configScheme().
